month_summary: November 1918 witnesses the final collapse of the Central Powers: Austria-Hungary signs armistice on November 3, Kaiser Wilhelm II abdicates on November 9, and the Great War ends with the Armistice at 11am on November 11. The Hundred Days Offensive achieves complete victory as Allied forces liberate Belgium and the Balkans. After four years and 8.5 million military deaths, the guns finally fall silent.
